agent_notes: The government_listing_sources field in the supplied context was empty, but the UGC government directory was independently queried and returned Sardar Patel University, ID 976, at Balaghat with status 2(f) & 12B.

Normal TLS to contacted official and government hosts produced the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests after confirming the expected hostnames.
The canonical official domain is spubgt.ac.in; similarly named spubgt.co.in and spubgt.in were not used as evidence.

The official site reports 49+ programmes, but the catalogue is partial: the Ayurvedic page names only undergraduate/postgraduate programme families without a detailed table; the Ph.D. notification is image-based and does not expose disciplines; the current admissions form lists additional family options that are not corroborated by detailed school tables; and several science programmes are shown only as unexplained acronyms.
Because catalogue completeness and several programme identities remain unresolved, the institution is manual_review and should not be imported as verified.
